links.comparator_used: National model (trained on national US EMR data) tested on the regional HIE dataset without retraining, after compatibility adjustments
links.outcome: Identification of adult-onset T1D initially coded as type 2 (AUROC and precision at 5% recall)
links.effect: AUROC 0.751 (national model) vs 0.774 (localized model); PR5 25.5% vs 35.4%
links.tradeoff: Localization added complexity and may impact scalability; data inconsistencies across HIE member organizations could undermine accuracy and providers' trust.
links.quote: The national model performed well on HIE data (AUROC = 0.751; precision at 5% recall [PR5] = 25.5%), and localization further improved performance (AUROC = 0.774; PR5 = 35.4%).

design_hint: local validation and retraining (localization) before deployment
